title: could we all be having similar dreams because we’re on similar medications?
content: i’m a psych major and it’s my goal to conduct research surrounding this phenomenon for my dissertation. i was explaining the whole thing to my boyfriend the other day and telling him how there are a bunch of people who share the same dream space. he brought up an interesting theory that it may be caused by medication such as SSRIs. one of the common side effects they warn you about when taking almost any psychotropic medication is intense dreams/nightmares, but reduction of dream recall is a major side effect for specifically SSRIs, which doesn’t really correlate. i can’t find any research on it past that, so this has really got me thinking lmao. i’m curious about how many of you are also on meds/which ones. i’m on sertraline (100mg) and adderall (20mg). i know this is probably the least fun theory out there but i think it’s worth looking into and a good starting point.
